name: Indirect Bounds + Domain Translation (XOR Parity)
description: Translates the vector space spanning problem into deducing the XOR sums of binary registers, removing all graph and vector terminology. Crucially, the explicit `m = n - 1` bound is replaced with a scenario-based indirect bound ("the minimum number of probes required to ensure the XOR sum of any pair... could be deduced"). Models relying on regex or shallow pattern matching for `m = n - 1` will fail to recognize the tree structure and thus fail to select the required O(n) tree-pruning algorithm, falling back to TLE-prone general graph approaches.
